feeds.title: ListenSD » San Diego Music Blog
feeds.description: ListenSD is a Music Media Outlet and Artist PR Firm specializing in creative promotion, artist development, and video marketing. Our mission is to provide a voice to San Diego's music scene through artist interviews, creative promotion, and artist development. ListenSD is a San Diego Music News blog giving you the skinny on the best local music & up-and-coming bands playing in San Diego.

feeds.title: KCR College Radio Blog
feeds.description: KCR is San Diego State University's premier college radio station. We are a student-run station that broadcasts live online for the SDSU and the greater San Diego community. Students can express themselves freely, and audiences get to experience the independence and creativity of a college radio station.

feeds.title: Music is 4 Lovers
feeds.description: Music is 4 Lovers is a media outlet, record label, online apparel store, and event brand dedicated to independent dance music. The blog section covers articles on music, interviews, premieres, labels, and new releases.

feeds.title: EDM Identity
feeds.description: EDM Identity strives to provide quality content about electronic dance music and the culture that surrounds it in the US and abroad. This is established by keeping up with and reporting on the happenings in our community while simultaneously promoting companies and artists on the rise. EDM Identity also provides the unique opportunity of giving fans that make up our scene a platform to express themselves and showcase their own involvement in the community.

feeds.title: 91X FM Blog
feeds.description: 91X is San Diego's Local Independent Radio. Find various playlists like Loudspeaker playlist, Planet Nü Nü Playlist, and many more along with some contest posts. We strive to provide a real-life learning experience for the broadcasting students at Loyalist. Our mission is not to be the most listened-to radio station in the region.

feeds.title: Klassik Arts Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to our Klassik Arts Blog page. Here you can find useful information related to what we do best! Teaching Music right and easy. You can explore a broad range of topics related to music learning and music education such as 'a different pianist you should know,' and 'How are flutes made.' Feel free to look through our blog site and leave any suggestions for improvement.

feeds.title: Saxophone Music San Diego Blog
feeds.description: Kevin Delmastro brings a visual and musical spectacle to lounges, cocktail parties, weddings, romantic dates, and many more. He specializes in giving a unique experience to his clients by catering to their tastes and style. If the event is mellow, he blends in with smooth background music.

feeds.title: Mr Ryan's Music and Books Blog
feeds.description: Mr. Ryan's Music is a fun music show for children. Kids of all ages like to learn about music and be entertained by Mr. Ryan's wit and musical wisdom. His Music Show lets kids sing and dance to fun beats their parents will love. His music has original songs and lyrics to children's songs. Mr. Ryan and pink bear love to share nursery rhymes, songs for toddlers and babies, and their favorite kid's songs.

feeds.title: The Che Underground
feeds.description: The Che Underground is a site and blog that is home to the inside story of the vibrant scene that flowered in San Diego in the 1980s and performed many of its most crucial shows at UCSD's Che Cafe.

feeds.title: SD Entertainer Magazine » Music & Arts
feeds.description: The San Diego Entertainer has been covering what's happening around San Diego for more than twenty years, and we are using that valuable experience to bring you the most provocative, informative, and timely information, using a format and technology that is proven to enhance the reader's experience. Read the Music and arts section that provides information on entertainment and theater in San Diego, art events, theater reviews, and theater company reviews around the County.

feeds.title: NBC 7 San Diego » SoundDiego
feeds.description: NBC 7 San Diego (KNSD-TV) is San Diego's only network-owned television station. Through accurate, engaging, and investigative storytelling, we provide information and context that helps viewers have a full understanding of what is happening across San Diego and in their neighborhoods. The Sound Diego section will give you articles about artists and the industry along with news and updates.

feeds.title: San Diego Union-Tribune » Music
feeds.description: The San Diego Union-Tribune is San Diego's largest media company and its oldest business, dating back to the founding of the Union in 1868. Part of the mission of The San Diego Union-Tribune is to build a stronger, more inclusive San Diego, through our coverage and our community events. Find the San Diego music scene, interviews with top performers coming to town, concert reviews, and more.

feeds.title: San Diego Magazine » Music
feeds.description: San Diego Magazine is a national award-winning media company covering the life, culture, and people of San Diego. No matter the topic - food, drink, art, music, theater, etc our creatives really know their stuff. Read the Music section to articles and blogs on arts, culture, attractions, and more ways to spend your weekend

feeds.title: San Diego Symphony Podcast
feeds.description: The San Diego Symphony presents Find Your Music™ On The Go with Navroj (Nuvi) Mehta, a pre-concert lecturer, multi-media presenter and community outreach resource. Nuvi dives deep into the classical music realm and the composers behind it.
